_doc: TENANT-REPO-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-22: "This is an app, a tenant, so it needs its own repo."): every tenant app lives in its own repository of the org; this repository keeps only its manifest (IDEA.md, instance.json, lifecycle.json, runway.json, README pointer). Read by foundation/tenantrepos.py (--check in checks) and by .github/workflows/tenant-repos.yml, which creates a missing repository from the tenant's folder with its history. The tenant's Worker is deployed by deploy-ultrastable, which builds it from the tenant repository named as `source` in doctrine/topology.json. TENANT-SANDBOX-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25: "All UltraStable deployments shall have their own GitHub repo and shall be sandboxed as tenant apps."): every tenant with a worker carries `sandbox` (its own stores named ultrastable-<slug>*, its own secret names, a daily budget whose D1 part is sampled by the tick through instances/ultrastable/cost-budgets.json); `tenantrepos --isolation` is the probe. States planned (manifest only; its repository is created before its first code, by the same workflow) and retired (no live deployment). TENANT-STANDARD-1: a repository's files come from the one scaffold (scaffold/tenant, written by foundation/tenantstd.py when --prepare runs), never from hand-typed blobs here; `vendor` always carries the base files of doctrine/tenant-standard.json and `scaffold` holds a tenant's declared options (beat_hours, noun).

spinoffs.why: the eight generated *.ultrastable.app apps shared one Worker and one D1 (ultrastable-spinoffs); all eight are retired (spinoffs/registry.json). A new spinoff launches as its own tenant repository; the check fails when a spinoff app is live again.

visitor_apps._doc: LAUNCH-PATH-1: an idea typed at ultrastable.io by someone with no code agent. Its launch record lives in the site's store (site/graduate.js); deploy/launch-apps.mjs (run daily by tenant-repos.yml) deploys its own system, creates its repository from the template, files the owner's requests there and invites the owner on request. Visitor apps have no folder under instances/: their manifest is generated from the idea.
